issues.parameter: K-band radio significance and radio-emission-site interpretation
issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 1: X-band Stokes I 79±14 μJy (~5.6σ); K-band 49±29 μJy (~1.7σ) but composite S/N=4.5. Table 2 7530±365 G assumes fundamental donor-coronal ECM; §4.2 also discusses accretion-column sites.
issues.why_it_matters: Counting a marginal K point as a second secure detection, or treating a conditional kG plasma field as a WD surface field, affects radio-incidence and field-population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: If band-specific incidence or source-site claims are needed, inspect/reprocess VLA visibility/source-finding products and confirm K-band Stokes-I significance and centroid. Until then preserve the reported point and composite S/N separately; keep ECM/donor-corona B conditional.

references.note: Local text and arXiv record inspected. HST/STIS low-state polar survey. ST LMi: first unambiguous WD-temperature measurement, Twd=10800 K for preferred two-temperature/cold-photosphere model, older estimates 12000-30000 K discussed, Porb=113.9 min tabulated, and distance 115 +/-21 pc. VV Pup: Twd=11900 K and older ~9000 K blackbody estimate superseded; Porb=100.4 min and B=31/56 MG tabulated. MR Ser: Twd=14200 K from FUV WD signature; discusses older MukaiCharles+86 Twd~9000/d=142 pc, Schwope+93 Twd=8500-10000 and M5-M6 donor/d=139 +/-13 pc, and argues FUV-based Twd is more accurate. TT Ari Table 7 lists Porb=198.0 min and WD temperature 39000 K, with reference 15 identified as Gaensicke et al. (1999). U Gem Table 7 compiles Porb=254.7 min and WD temperature 31000 K, with references 19=Sion et al. (1998) and 20=Long & Gilliland (1999). ST LMi: HST/STIS low-state spectrum, 2003-05-28. Table 5 WD models: 10.9(+0.5/-0.4) kK single component; preferred two-component cold photosphere 10.8(+0.5/-0.4) kK with fixed 50 kK hot component. Table 6 model-scaling distances 117(+22/-23) and 115(+21/-22) pc. Errors are driven by assumed WD mass/log g; E(B-V)=0 adopted for best fits, not a measured zero extinction. RX And Table 7 value checked as a compilation carrying Sion+01; it is not an independent fit. VV Pup closeout 2026-09-25: Table 5 preferred two-WD cold component 11.9+/-0.6 kK; single-WD alternative 12.3+/-0.7 kK; hot 50 kK component fixed. Visually checked p.13 distance is 151(+28/-34) pc. U Gem continuation: Table 7 and references 19–20 checked locally; its 31,000 K entry is a compilation from Sion+98 and Long & Gilliland+99, not an independent WD fit.

references.note: Present/local. Radio survey of magnetic CVs. Her 1 audit: Table lists Her 1 as AM with K-band VLA flux 48 +/-17 uJy, +100 +/-45 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.00?, distance=1030 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; no source-specific WD surface MG field, WD Teff, WD mass, or donor properties are provided. Her 1 identity remains unresolved because the source coordinate in combined_mcv_sources.csv/Barrett table (RA=244.95543, Dec=+14.88610) conflicts with a previous supplemental SDSS/Gaia association. Cas 1 audit: Table lists C-band flux 21 +/-10 uJy, -100 +/-39 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.9396 h, distance=1608 pc, and radio-inferred B=1960 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1503-2207 audit: Table lists X-band flux 29 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-14 percent circular polarization, Porb=2.2228 h, distance=392 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FR Lyn correction after rendered Table 1 check: FR Lyn has only the Semester 18A X-band row, I=28 +/-4 uJy, RR=12 +/-6, LL=38 +/-6, CP=-52 +/-17%, offset=0.13 +/-0.22 arcsec, composite S/N1=43.3. The 49 +/-29 uJy K-band row with +37 +/-57% CP belongs to VV Pup Semester 13B. FR Lyn has no radio-inferred B entry in Table 2. BM CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 43 +/-15 uJy, -100 +/-41 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4040 h, distance=419 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. Hya 1 audit: Pelisoli+24 Appendix explicitly maps Hya 1 to RX J0859.1+0537; the prior Gaia DR3 5745881603063095680 match was a different source, MM Hya. Barrett+20 reports X-band Stokes I 6±6 μJy and custom S/N 7.3, but Ridder+23 treats the point as below 3σ. Its 2.3966 h and 441 pc values are consistent with the RX J0859 literature and Gaia DR2/EDR3 distances; the 3563±730 G inference remains conditional radio-plasma field, not WD surface field. V388 Peg audit: Table lists X-band flux 34 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-12 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3751 h, distance=689 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FL Cet audit: Table lists X-band flux 11 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-53 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4523 h, distance=319 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-pole field measured from cyclotron harmonics by Schmidt+05_FLCet. LW Cam audit: Table lists X-band flux 50 +/-4 uJy, -100 +/-9 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.6211 h, distance=542 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; Section 4.2 identifies a narrow ~10.295 GHz feature and derives ~3.6 kG for the radio plasma while adopting/citing Bwd~20 MG from Ferrario+15/Tovmassian+01_LWCam. The kG value is not the WD surface field. ST LMi audit: Table lists X-band flux 153 +/-12 uJy, circular polarization entry near -100 +/-20 percent in the OCR/local text, Porb=1.8981 h, distance=113 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. V603 Aql audit: Table lists C-band 22 +/-3 uJy and X-band 32 +/-7 uJy with high circular-polarization fractions and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; Section 4.2 notes the system was included because RKcat had possible-IP context, but later work associates the photometric period with superhump/disk precession. Barrett+20 argue any WD field must be weak (<1 kG) or it would truncate the disk, so the kG radio value is not a WD surface field. MQ Dra audit: Table lists X-band flux 17 +/-4 uJy with +100 +/-34 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.3912 h, distance=186 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-region field. AP CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 24 +/-4 uJy with weak circular polarization (-5 +/-22 percent), Porb=2.5310 h, distance=209 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. V1007 Her audit: Table lists X-band flux 38 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-29 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.9988 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/cyclotron field measured by Greiner+98_V1007Her. V1323 Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 43 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-20 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.4016 h, distance=2244 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AM Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 88 +/-5 uJy, plus additional X/K-band detections summarized elsewhere in the paper; Table 2 gives Porb=3.0942 h, distance=88 pc, and no radio-inferred B value for AM Her. V1432 Aql audit: Table lists X-band flux 15 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-47 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3656 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1955+0045 audit: Table lists X-band flux 79 +/-5 uJy with circular polarization -2 +/-6 percent, Porb=1.3932 h, distance=171 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. QQ Vul audit: Table lists K-band flux 92 +/-39 uJy with -100 +/-60 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.7084 h, distance=317 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AE Aqr audit: Table lists C-, X-, and K-band detections 5123 +/-9, 5497 +/-11, and 8031 +/-34 uJy with circular polarization 0 +/-1 percent; Table 2 lists Porb=9.8797 h, distance=91 pc, radio flux 8031 uJy, and radio luminosity 1628 (table units), with no radio-inferred B value for AE Aqr. HU Aqr audit: Table 1/2 lists X-band radio flux 44 +/-13 uJy with circular polarization -60 +/-23 percent, Porb=2.0836 h, distance about 192 pc, and no radio-inferred B value; no component masses, Teff, or WD surface field are provided. EQ Cet audit: Table 1 K-band Stokes-I flux 96 +/- 30 microJy and circular polarization +100 +/- 70%; Table 2 7530 +/- 365 G assumes fundamental ECM from donor corona; field uncertainty is based on central frequency/bandwidth, not a WD-surface field measurement. BS Tri: Table 1 gives VLA X band 7.964–10.012 GHz, Stokes I 57±9 μJy, RR 49±16 μJy, LL 0±15 μJy and circular polarization +100±45%; semester 2015A, exact date/state unstated. Table 2 field 3210±365 G is conditional on fundamental ECM and is radio-plasma/donor-coronal context, not WD field. The generic Ridder+23 exclusion of some sub-3σ Barrett detections does not apply to BS Tri (I/σ≈6.3). references.note: Original ApJ abstract/metadata web-verified for Wickramasinghe, Ferrario & Bailey (1989), ApJ 342, L35-L38, 'A 56 MG field at the second pole in VV Puppis'. Phase-dependent spectropolarimetry gives B=30.5 MG at the main region and B=56 MG at the secondary region; the paper interprets the system with an offset dipole displaced by about 0.1 Rwd. The later Schwope+97 analysis refines these to approximately 31 and 54 MG in its state-dependent model.
